reports.title: Reports
reports.pageIntro: Club snapshot: payments and refunds follow the selected range; installment rows sum successful payments on installment contracts. Client counts are point-in-time — “Active” uses contract dates (current service period), not only the status field in the profile.
reports.periodApplied: Finance metrics use {from} – {to}; Activity (visits, new clients, new contracts) uses the same date range.

blocks.salesHint: Revenue counts Paid payments. Installment rows sum/count Paid payments tied to contracts with an installment plan. Refunds use Refunded status. Failed payments appear only if there were any in the range. Trend compares this window with the prior window of equal length.
blocks.clientsHint: Independent of the dates above. “Active” means at least one contract in a derived ACTIVE period (by service dates), aligned with contracts logic even if the profile status is stale.
blocks.activitySubtitle: Visits and sign-ups in the period
blocks.activityHint: All three metrics use the selected range: gym visits, new client profiles created, and contracts created.
blocks.quickHint: Open lists for details and actions.
